application: Unmodified DataExplorer 4.0.8 beta 3, integrated TA612C plugin

environment.profile: Isolated profile; default beta toolbar layout; no meter acquisition

method: Native OSD file chooser, AT-SPI activation of the actual View menu actions, XTest pointer clicks and Ctrl+PageUp events. Read-only Java agent inspected active values/timestamps, CTabFolder selection, tabSelectedIndex, selector text and canvasImage pixels on the SWT thread. It did not select tabs, redraw or modify measurement data.
scope: Saved-file follow-up after the physical tests. No new physical acquisition or application fix. No independent human review of these software checks.
model_digest_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(model, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon)) after excluding the process-local identity field. Model values and times are unchanged; they are stored once per file below.
capture_extracts: Original capture basenames and hashes identify retained snapshots. Process-local identity numbers and window-title details are omitted; selected-tab fields, model values/times, curve-selector rows and cached-image hashes are unchanged.
limits: Linux GTK3/X11 and these two saved TA612C files only.
The return to Graphic with native Ctrl+PageDown was not separately tested. Its source path shares switchNextTabulator with the next-tab menu action.

The source/class correspondence for DataExplorer and MenuBar is the separately published earlier comparison. GraphicsWindow/GraphicsComposite and SWT were inspected as source/distributed bytecode; no new whole application compilation is claimed.
